Education to All by 2003
*161.SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Minister has given an
assurance that all the children would be
provided schooling by 2003;
(b) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to implement this assurance;
and
(c) what steps both the Centre and States
have taken together, to achieve this
objective?
Vocational relevance to education
*162. SHRI  MOOLCHAND MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government and industry
feel that Indian education system does not
equip students with skills and is not job-
oriented;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made vocational education a focus area, and
industry and corporate bodies have been
roped in, as part of the effort to provide
education with vocational relevance;
(c) whether this question was also
discussed at the Conference of State
Education Secretaries, held in August, 2002;
and
(d) if so, to what extent States have agreed
to implement the suggestions made in the
Conference in this regard?
Dope test-failed Indian weight-lifter at
Manchester
*163. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister  of  YOUTH  AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news report captioned,
"Manchester drug disgrace-Government
knew there was suspect in team", which
appeared in the Indian Express dated the
3rd September, 2002;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Indian

weight-lifter, who had won the gold medal
was tested positive shortly before he left
India; and
(c) if so, how he was cleared for the
games and what are the reasons for the lapse?
Over bridge at Kesamudram and
Khammam railway stations
*164. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether overbridges at Kesamudram
and Khammam railway stations are
proposed to be constructed;
(b) if so, the details of allocations made
therefor; and
(c) by when the work would be taken up
and completed?
Bamboo flowering
*165. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the phenomenal causes of bamboo
flowering and its repeatability, predictions,
implications, including famine, based on past
experience;
(b) what is the probable period of
bamboo flowering, action taken by the
Ministry to face the situation, State-wise;
and
(c) the utility of bamboo seeds, if any,
because of enhancing prolificacy of rats?
Cleanliness in Railway coaches
*166. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cleanliness,
maintenance and upkeep of rail coaches are
not upto the mark, causing inconvenience
to the rail passengers; and
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to improve the situation?
Problems of Mahila Mandal in H.P.
†*167. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had received
any representation in August, 2002 about
the problems of Mahila Mandal, Nandla,
District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh;
(b) if so, the action taken by Government
on their problems and whether Government
propose to provide financial assistance to
promote Mahila Mandal;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Financial assistance for sports persons
*168. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state the names of
sports persons given pension/lumpsum
financial assistance under the existing
scheme of National Welfare Fund for Sports
Persons", during the last three years,
year-wise?
Gadwal-Raichur rail line
*169. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Gadwal-Raichur rail line
work has started;
(b) if so, the total cost of the project; and
(c) the amount allocated for this project
in the financial year 2002-2003?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Milk quality standards
1041. SHRI C. P. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASU: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
revise the milk quality standards and the
mandatory screening at farmers' level, to
ensure infection-free and good quality milk
for processing and exports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Bureau of Indian
Standards has been asked to lay down the
quality parameters for milk;
(d) if so, the recommendations of BIS in
this regard; and
(e) the reaction of Government thereto?
Inter-Ministerial Task Force on Agro
Marketing
1042. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
refer to answer to Unstarred Question 1054,
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 26th July,
2002 and state the status of implementation
of the report of Inter-Ministerial Task Force
on Agro Marketing?
Fruit and vegetable production
1043. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there has been a substantial
increase in the production of fruits and
vegetables in the country;
(b) if so, in what ways the fruits and
vegetables produced in the country are
utilised;
(c) whether any possibility has been
explored by Government to increase the
export of fruits and vegetables; and
(d) if so, the performance in that regard
during the last three years, year-wise?
Opening of a dairy in Uttar Pradesh
1044. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to open a dairy in Uttar Pradesh
during the current financial year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of financial allocations
made, so far, in this respect; and

WIN2\SESSION\3921RS 231
(d) by when the proposal is likely to be
implemented?
MSP for Copra
1045. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the MSP for Copra has been
fixed at Rs. 3300 and Rs. 3555 per quintal,
for milling and ball copra, respectively;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken note of the low productivity-rate and
the high cost of cultivation, before fixing
the MSP;
(c) whether Government have received
any requests from the State Governments
for raising the MSP; and
(d) if so, the details of the request
received and the action taken by
Government thereon?
Cultivation on rain-fed land
†1046. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
‘LALAN’: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cultivation on
most of the rain-fed land proves to be
unremunerative;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government have made any
assessment regarding the financial gains
accruing from cultivation on such land; and
(d) if so, the per hectare of profits by
cultivation on such land?
Students in ICAR agricultural
universities
1047. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the agricultural universities
under the Indian Council of Agricultural
Research (ICAR) had admitted about 100
foreign students during the last year;
(b) whether ICAR has set up a target for
increasing admissions of foreign students
into its deemed universities by five times,
over the next year;
(c) if so, what steps are being taken in
this regard; and
(d) how many foreign students are
studying in ICAR's deemed universities this
year?
Assistance under agricultural scheme
to NGOs
†1048. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of schemes being run by
the Ministry of Agriculture under which
financial assistance is provided to Non-
Governmental Organisations;
(b) the details of funds allocated to Bihar
and Chhattisgarh, organisation-wise and
scheme-wise, during the last three years;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
provide benefit of these schemes at village
level?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Bovine development scheme
†1049. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
formulate or have formulated any rural
development scheme for protecting, tending
and breeding of bovine in different States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the reaction of Government in this
regard?
